# temps_error_inbound_filter (Resource)

A rule that drops matching error events of a project before they are stored, so they neither count against quotas nor trigger alerts. It applies from the next event.

The built-in kinds (`browser_extensions`, `web_crawlers`, `localhost`) can exist once per project; `error_message` and `release` rules match a pattern and can be repeated.

Import with `<project_id>/<filter_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `error_tracking:read`, `error_tracking:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

# Drop events reported from local development machines.
resource "temps_error_inbound_filter" "localhost" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  kind       = "localhost"
}

# Drop a known, harmless browser error.
resource "temps_error_inbound_filter" "resize_observer" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  kind       = "error_message"
  pattern    = "*ResizeObserver loop*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) What the rule drops: `browser_extensions`, `web_crawlers`, `localhost`, `error_message`, `release`. Changing it replaces the filter.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project. Changing it replaces the filter.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule drops events. Defaults to `true`.
- `pattern` (String) Glob, required for `error_message` (matched against `Type: message`) and `release`, and not allowed for the other kinds. `*` matches any run of characters and `?` one; matching ignores case. At most 200 characters.

### Read-Only

- `dropped_count` (Number) Events the rule dropped since it was created, as of the last refresh.
- `id` (String) Numeric filter ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<filter_id>
terraform import temps_error_inbound_filter.localhost 3/7
```
